newsitem.title: USA: U.S West Coast crudes finish down, lack of players.
newsitem.headline: U.S West Coast crudes finish down, lack of players.

text.p: U.S. West Coast light crudes finished weaker late Thursday, with players in the Alaskan crude spot market withholding bids and offers until a Valdez ballast-water treatment plant regains full capacity.
With differentials static, Alaska North Slope (ANS) was left to track lower West Texas Intermediate (WTI) levels.
"Both parties have withdrawn until the situation has resolved itself," a buyer said.
The plant allows oil tankers to discharge oil ballast water before they load cargoes of ANS. During the shutdown, they were held up or partially loaded.
